title: projects.finance_request.cancelled, schema_version 1
description: Finance confirms the cancellation Projects asked for. Contract: docs/finance/finance-projects-contract.md.

organization_id.description: The organization, as in the envelope (Projects refuses a mismatch).

sequence.description: Finance's count of outcomes for this request, from 1 with no gaps. Projects applies them in order: a gap is answered 503 (retry), an older number 409.

status.description: Finance's own status for the request after this outcome (authoritative in Finance; Projects keeps its own request status).

finance_reference.description: Finance's reference (its payment request number); null until Finance takes the request in.
